messages:
maria_sales: Quick ask — Acme Health POC kicks off Mon. Embedding-heavy test, roughly 3M tokens/day for ~14 days. Can we do a temporary per-token hosted override to $0.0004/token (standard is $0.0006) and waive the min charge for the POC? Need a short pricing note for the SOW. cc @jack_revenue @nina_finance
jack_revenue: Do we have commitment from them to conversion after POC or is this strictly a timeboxed eval? Also, is that 3M "tokens" really embedding input tokens (we price embeddings differently)?
mar ia_sales: It's embeddings input tokens (means many short texts). No signed commit yet — customer expects a lightweight eval but said positive signals would move to paid. The 3M/day is our ask from their forecast: total ~42M tokens over 2 weeks.
sam_eng: technically we can reduce billable tokens by batching + local caching of repeated prompts. If they can batch 64 per request and we enable prefix dedupe, rough cut could be ~25% tokens. worth proposing to them.
jack_revenue: OK. Two options from rev side: (1) short promo credit ($5k trial credit applied to hosted usage) or (2) temporary per-token rate cut for the POC tracked in the deal desk with a follow-up conversion milestone. Which would they prefer?
maria_sales: they asked for per-token number in SOW, but $5k credit might be easier to approve. They want the clean per-token rate in docs though.
olivia_sec: heads-up — Acme Health will process PHI. Can we confirm if data will be de-identified? If not, hosted API might need a BAA + additional controls; Private deployment could be required. Not a blocker for pricing but could change deployment and cost.
maria_sales: they're saying data will be partially deidentified, but legal still wants BAA language. I'm checking with their legal.
nina_finance: Deal desk rules — price overrides >20% need finance + legal signoff. For a 33% per-token cut (0.0006 -> 0.0004) we'd need an approved exception. If timeline is tight, $5k promo credit is faster (manager-level ok). Suggest we offer the $5k trial credit + document the requested per-token rate in the SOW as a "target rate" conditional on commit.
jack_revenue: Agree. Offer structure: apply $5k hosted usage credit now, include a conversion clause: if they sign a 6mo commit within 60 days, we retroactively apply the per-token rate at $0.00045 for first 3 months. Need deal-desk ticket and legal to draft one-pager.
mar ia_sales: That hybrid sounds good. Can you open the deal-desk ticket? I'll push for the BAA concurrently.
deal-desk-bot: Created ticket DD-2026-089: "Acme Health POC — trial credit + conversion rate request" assigned to jack_revenue. Required approvals: finance, legal. ETA for review: 48h. :white_check_mark:
jack_revenue: I'll own the ticket and escalate if we don't get sign-off in 48h. Nina — can you pre-approve manager-level credit so we can apply $5k immediately once they sign the SOW?
nina_finance: Pre-approve $5k trial credit for this POC; finance will review the DD ticket for rate exception. Legal needs to confirm BAA terms before any hosted PHI ingestion.
sam_eng: FYI if legal dictates hosted is not allowed for PHI, call out Private deployment cost delta in the SOW so sales doesn't get surprised (roughly +30% infra surcharge).
maria_sales: noted. I'll update the SOW draft: include the $5k credit, the conditional per-token target rate, and a note about BAA/Private deployment if required. Thanks everyone.
jack_revenue: Action items: (1) dd ticket opened (DD-2026-089) — jack to own, (2) apply $5k promo once SOW signed — nina to confirm, (3) legal to review BAA — olivia to follow, (4) maria to update SOW with conditional rate language.
maria_sales: ETA — SOW draft update by EOD today. Will ping when sent. :rocket:
